name: hud_ui_zrd_widget_ex17c_item_constructor
description: HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C_Item::Constructor initializes the base ZRD widget, installs the item ftable, clears the selected state, owner pointer, mouse-rect override flag, and selected/unselected default image pointers.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C item/table pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b8760 validates the call to HudUiZrdWidget::Constructor, ftable write to g_HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C_Item_Vtbl, and zero writes to offsets 0x14c, 0x150, 0x158, 0x16c, and 0x170.

The native smoke verifies constructor ftable installation, selected and owner state reset, mouse-rect override reset, selectedImage and unselectedImage reset, and preservation of itemIndex plus rollover image pointers.
